objective: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take his written plea to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.

description: Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.
Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
progress: Hail, <class>. What business do you have with The People's Militia?
completion: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
